<header data-responsive="print">
<a class="logo highlight" href="https://www.mooble.com/br">
<img src="https://cdn.mooble.com/logo/mooblecom/mooblecom-black.png"/>
</a>
</header>
<header data-bindwith="header" id="pageHeader">
<h1 title="mooble">
<a class="logo highlight" href="/br" target="_top">
<img alt="mooble.com" src="https://cdn.mooble.com/logo/mooblecom/mooblecom.png"/>
</a>
</h1>
<div data-position="right" data-role="toolbar">
<button class="header-menu-trigger btn-flat" id="regions-button">
<img alt="" class="flag-icon" onerror="this.src='data:image/png;base64,';" src="https://cdn.mooble.com/sitesimages/Icons/flag-br.png"/>
                        BR
                    </button>
</div>
<div data-position="right" data-responsive="small medium" data-role="toolbar">
<button class="header-menu-trigger btn-flat" data-action="toggleMenu" title="Menu">
<i class="fa fa-bars"></i>
<i class="fa fa-caret-down"></i>
</button>
</div>
<nav data-position="right" data-role="toolbar">
<ul class="header-separator" data-responsive="normal large">
<li>
<a data-action="goToLogin" href="https://www.mooble.com/br/Login?ReturnUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fmooble.com%2Fbr">
<i class="warning-text fa fa-lock"></i>
<span>Login</span>
</a>
</li>
</ul>
<button class="header-menu-trigger btn-flat" data-bind="title: localization.header.notificationTitle(mooble.web.user.notificationsViewModel.notificationsUnread())" data-group="header-notifications" data-role="notifications" style="display:none" title="0 notificações não lidas">
<i class="fa fa-bell-o"></i>
<div data-bind="visible: mooble.web.user.notificationsViewModel.notificationsUnread() &gt; 0, text: mooble.web.user.notificationsViewModel.notificationsUnread" style="display: none;">0</div>
</button>
</nav>
<nav data-position="right" data-responsive="normal large" data-role="toolbar">
<a href="https://www.mooble.com/br/mooble-design">
<div class="btn-sign-header">
<span>Experimente o Mooble Design</span>
</div>
</a>
<a href="/br/projetos/destaques">
<span>Galeria</span>
</a>

<span>
                        
                    Projeto
                </span>
</a>
</nav>

<section data-role="page" id="homepage">
<section id="main-section">
<section class="container-fluid" id="main-content">
<div class="row">
<div class="col-sm-12 col-md-6" id="slogan">
<h1>Crie seu ambiente <br/>com produtos reais!</h1>
<p class="text">Tenha liberdade para criar<br/>
Utilize produtos que você pode comprar<br/>
Inspire-se com os projetos da galeria<br/>
Encontre uma loja<br/></p>
<a class="home-cta-button" data-role="button" href="https://planner.mooble.com/br" title="Inicie um projeto!">
<span>Inicie um projeto!</span>
</a>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="customers">
<div class="customer-type">
<h2>Fabricante</h2>
<hr/>
<p> Fortaleça seus canais de venda<br/>
com seus produtos no Mooble. </p>
<button class="customer-cta-button" data-action="showModal" data-group="manufacturer">
                        Entre em contato
                    </button>
</div>
<div class="customer-type">
<h2>E-commerce</h2>
<hr/>
<p> Não limite as opções do seu site.<br/>
Venda ambientes personalizados. </p>
<button class="customer-cta-button" data-action="showModal" data-group="ecommerce">
                        Entre em contato
                    </button>
</div>
<div class="customer-type">
<h2>Lojista</h2>
<hr/>
<p> Receba projetos para orçar<br/>
Tenha acesso à listagem detalhada do projeto </p>
<a class="customer-cta-button" data-role="button" href="https://www.mooble.com/br/mooble-design" id="store-register">

                </a>
</div>
</section>

<section data-group="fale-conosco" data-role="modal">
<header>
<h2>Fale Conosco</h2>
</header>
<div>
<p>Deixe seus dados e entraremos em contato.</p>
<form>
<fieldset data-type="list">
<div data-role="field">
<label>Nome</label>
<input data-type="name" type="text"/>
</div>
<div data-role="field">
<label>E-mail</label>
<input data-type="email" type="email"/>
</div>

<script type="text/javascript"> 

    Math.roundDecimal = function (value, decimal) {
        var base = Math.pow(10, decimal);
        return Math.round(value * base) / base;
    };
    var formatTitle = function (title) {
        var result = "Mooble";

        if (title)
            result = title + " - Mooble";

        //if (mooble.web.partnership.name)
        //    result += " " + mooble.web.partnership.displayName;

        return result;
    };

    var decodeEntities = (function () {
        // this prevents any overhead from creating the object each time
        var element = document.createElement('div');

        function decodeHTMLEntities(str) {
            if (str && typeof str === 'string') {
                // strip script/html tags
                str = str.replace(/<script[^>]*>([\S\s]*?)<\/script>/gmi, '');
                str = str.replace(/<\/?\w(?:[^"'>]|"[^"]*"|'[^']*')*>/gmi, '');
                element.innerHTML = str;
                str = element.textContent;
                element.textContent = '';
            }

            return str;
        }

        return decodeHTMLEntities;
    })();
    var decodeObj = function (obj) {
        for (var key in obj) {
            var child = obj[key];
            if (typeof (child) === "string") {
                obj[key] = decodeEntities(child);
            }
            else {
                decodeObj(child);
            }
        }
    };

    var cultureName = "pt-br";
    var currencySymbol = "R$";
    var decimalSeparator = ",";
    var language = "pt";
    var region = "br";
    var locates = [cultureName, language, decodeEntities("cm"), decodeEntities("m")];

    var numberFormats = {};
    var getNumberFormat = function (decimalDigits, language, useGrouping) {
        var key = [language, useGrouping, decimalDigits].join("|");
        var result = numberFormats[key];
        if (!result) {
            result = numberFormats[key] = new Intl.NumberFormat(language, {
                useGrouping: useGrouping == null || useGrouping === true,
                minimumFractionDigits: decimalDigits,
                maximumFractionDigits: decimalDigits,
            });
        }
        return result;
    }

    var formatNumber = function (value, decimalDigits, language, useGrouping) {
        if (typeof value === "string")
            return value;
        var nf = getNumberFormat(decimalDigits, language, useGrouping);
        return nf.format(value);
    };
    var parseNumber = function (value) {
        if (!value)
            return null;
        if (typeof value === "number")
            return value;
        value = value.replace(decimalSeparator === "." ? "," : ".", "");
        return parseFloat(value.replace(decimalSeparator, "."));
    };
    var formatPrice = function (value, decimalDigits) {
        return value.toLocaleString(language, {
            useGrouping: true,
            minimumFractionDigits: decimalDigits,
            maximumFractionDigits: decimalDigits,
        });
    };
    var formatNumberWithoutGrouping = function (value, decimalDigits, language) {
        return value.toLocaleString(
            language,
            {
                useGrouping: false,
                minimumFractionDigits: decimalDigits,
                maximumFractionDigits: decimalDigits,
            });
    };
    var convertToMM = function (value, unit) {
        var number = parseNumber(value);
        switch (unit) {
            case "m":
                return Math.roundDecimal(number * 1000.0, 2);
            case "cm":
                return Math.roundDecimal(number * 10.0, 2);
            case "in":
                return Math.roundDecimal(number * 25.4, 2);
            case "ft":
                return Math.roundDecimal(number * 304.8, 2);
            case "mm":
                return Math.roundDecimal(number, 0);
        }
    };
    var convertFromMM = function (value, unit) {
        var number = parseNumber(value);
        switch (unit) {
            case "m":
                return Math.roundDecimal(number / 1000.0, 2);
            case "cm":
                return Math.roundDecimal(number / 10.0, 2);
            case "in":
                return Math.roundDecimal(number / 25.4, 2);
            case "ft":
                return Math.roundDecimal(number / 304.8, 2);
            case "mm":
                return Math.roundDecimal(number, 0);
        }
    };

    var unit = "m";
    var unit2 = "cm";
    var unit3 = "mm";

    window.localization = window.localization || {};

    window.localization.data = {
        name: cultureName,
        language: language,
        locates: locates,
        locate: locates.join(","),
        region: region,
        regions: ['br&#39;, &#39;us&#39;, &#39;es&#39;, &#39;mx&#39;, &#39;pe&#39;, &#39;ac&#39;, &#39;ar&#39;, &#39;cn'],
        currency: currencySymbol,
        currencyTo: function (value, currency) {
            return (currency || currencySymbol) + " " + formatNumber(value, 2, cultureName);
        },
        format: function (value, minDecimalDigits, maxDecimalDigits) {
            if (!value)
                return "NaN";
            if (minDecimalDigits == null)
                minDecimalDigits = 2;
            if (maxDecimalDigits == null)
                maxDecimalDigits = 2;
            return value.toLocaleString(
                cultureName,
                {
                    minimumFractionDigits: minDecimalDigits,
                    maximumFractionDigits: maxDecimalDigits,
                });
        },
        parseNumber: parseNumber,
        unit: {
            title: unit,
            valueToMM: function (value) {
                return convertToMM(value, decodeEntities(unit));
            },
            valueFromMM: function (value) {
                return convertFromMM(value, decodeEntities(unit));
            },
            format: function (value, symbol) {
                var converted = convertFromMM(value, decodeEntities(unit));
                var decimalPlaces = unit == "mm" ? 0 : (unit == "cm" ? 1 : (unit == "m" ? 3 : 2)); //Casas Decimais: "mm" -> 0 | "cm" -> 1 | "in","ft" -> 2 | "m" -> 3
                var result = formatNumber(converted, decimalPlaces, cultureName, false);
                if (symbol == null || symbol === true)
                    result += unit2;
                return result;
            }
        },
        unit2: {
            title: unit2,
            valueToMM: function (value) {
                return convertToMM(value, decodeEntities(unit2));
            },
            valueFromMM: function (value) {
                return convertFromMM(value, decodeEntities(unit2));
            },
            format: function (value, symbol) {
                var converted = convertFromMM(value, decodeEntities(unit2));
                var decimalPlaces = unit2 == "mm" ? 0 : (unit2 == "cm" ? 1 : (unit2 == "m" ? 3 : 2)); //Casas Decimais: "mm" -> 0 | "cm" -> 1 | "in","ft" -> 2 | "m" -> 3
                var result = formatNumber(converted, decimalPlaces, cultureName, false);
                if (symbol == null || symbol === true)
                    result += unit2;
                return result;
            }
        },
        unit3: {
            title: unit3,
            valueToMM: function (value) {
                return convertToMM(value, decodeEntities(unit3));
            },
            valueFromMM: function (value) {
                return convertFromMM(value, decodeEntities(unit3));
            },
            format: function (value, symbol) {
                var converted = convertFromMM(value, decodeEntities(unit3));
                var decimalPlaces = unit3 == "mm" ? 0 : (unit3 == "cm" ? 1 : (unit3 == "m" ? 3 : 2)); //Casas Decimais: "mm" -> 0 | "cm" -> 1 | "in","ft" -> 2 | "m" -> 3
                var result = formatNumber(converted, decimalPlaces, cultureName, false);
                if (symbol == null || symbol === true)
                    result += unit3;
                return result;
            }
        },
        units: {
            M: "m",
            M2: "m&#178;",
        },
    };

    window.localization.header = {
        title: "Mooble",
        noNotifications: "N&#227;o h&#225; notifica&#231;&#245;es.",
        explorer: "M&#243;dulos",
        messageBudget: decodeEntities("Voc&#234; possui uma negocia&#231;&#227;o pendente."),
        messageNewBudget: decodeEntities("Voc&#234; possui uma nova solicita&#231;&#227;o de or&#231;amento."),
        newComment: function (account) {
            return account + decodeEntities('  comentou o seu projeto');
        },
        newMessage: function (name, count) {
            if (count == 1)
                return decodeEntities("Voc&#234; recebeu ") + decodeEntities(" mensagem") + (" de ") + name;

            return decodeEntities("Voc&#234; recebeu ") + count + decodeEntities(" mensagens") + (" de ") + name;
        },
        newAccount: function (nameAccount, notificationType) {
            if (notificationType == 'Account')
                return decodeEntities("Voc&#234; possui uma nova conta:  ") + nameAccount;
            else if (notificationType == 'ChangePermissionsAccount')
                return decodeEntities('Suas permiss&#245;es da conta  ') + nameAccount + decodeEntities(' foram alteradas');
            else if (notificationType == 'DeleteAccountToUser')
                return decodeEntities('Voc&#234; foi removido da conta ') + nameAccount;

            return '';
        },
        tablePriceRequest: function (nameAccount, brand) {
            return '<b>' + nameAccount + '</b>' + decodeEntities('  solicitou acesso &#224; tabela de pre&#231;os da marca ') + '<b>' + brand + '</b>';
        },
        tablePriceRequestApproval: function (nameAccount, brand) {
            return '<b>' + nameAccount + '</b>' + decodeEntities('  alterou sua permiss&#227;o de acesso &#224; tabela de pre&#231;os da marca ') + '<b>' + brand + '</b>';
        },
        tablePriceUpdated: function (accountName, brand) {
            return '<b>' + accountName + '</b> ' + decodeEntities("A tabela de pre&#231;os foi atualizada ap&#243;s a digita&#231;&#227;o manual desse pre&#231;o") + ' <b>' + brand + '</b>';
        },
        notificationTitle: function (count) {
            if (count == 1)
                return count + decodeEntities(" notifica&#231;&#227;o n&#227;o lida");
            else
                return count + decodeEntities(" notifica&#231;&#245;es n&#227;o lidas");
        },
    };

    window.localization.feedback = {
        thanks: "Obrigado por sua mensagem.",
        error: "Ocorreu um erro ao enviar sua mensagem"
    };

</script>
<script type="text/javascript">

    window.localization.me = {
        myDesigns: {
            title: decodeEntities("Meus projetos"),
            liked: decodeEntities("Projetos que curti"),
            managerUsers: decodeEntities("Gerenciamento de Usu&#225;rios"),

            sucessImportProductsInfo: decodeEntities("Importa&#231;&#227;o realizada com sucesso!"),

            formatInvalidProductsInfo: decodeEntities("Formato do arquivo inv&#225;lido"),
            projectSuccessfullyDeleted: decodeEntities("Projeto deletado com sucesso"),
            errorDeletingProject: decodeEntities("Erro ao deletar projeto"),
            projectSuccessfullyCloned: decodeEntities("Projeto clonado com sucesso"),
            file: "Arquivo",
            cancel: "Cancelar",
            yes: "Sim",
            privateProject: "Projeto privado",
            approve: decodeEntities("Aprovar"),
            refuse: decodeEntities("Recusar"),
            count: function (total, singular, plural) {
                singular = (singular || decodeEntities("projeto")).toLowerCase();
                plural = (plural || decodeEntities("projetos")).toLowerCase();
                var totalString = total !== undefined ? total.toLocaleString(localization.data.name) : "0";
                return decodeEntities("Apresentando ") + totalString + " " + (total !== undefined && total === 1 ? singular : plural);
            },
            getCount: function (count, status) {
                switch (status) {
                    case 'Pending':
                        return 'Total encontrado: ' + count.toString().replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ".");
                    case 'Approved':
                        return 'Total encontrado: ' + count.toString().replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ".");
                    case 'Denied':
                        return 'Total encontrado: ' + count.toString().replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ".");
                }
            },
            getTitle: function (title, date) {
                switch (title) {
                    case 'SentToCart':
                        return decodeEntities('No Carrinho');
                    case 'StoreSentToCart':
                        return decodeEntities('Solicitado');
                    case 'UnderNegotiation':
                        return decodeEntities('Em negocia&#231;&#227;o');
                    case 'Sold':
                        return decodeEntities('Vendido');
                    case 'Opened':
                        return decodeEntities('Aberta');
                    case 'Lost':
                        return decodeEntities('Perdido');
                    case 'Exported':
                        return decodeEntities('Exportado');
                    case 'All':
                        return decodeEntities('Todos');
                }
            },
            getType: function (data) {
                switch (data) {
                    case 'Ecommerce':
                        return decodeEntities('E-commerce');
                    case 'PhysicalStore':
                        return decodeEntities('Loja f&#237;sica');
                    case 'All':
                        return decodeEntities('Todos');
                }
            },
            getStatus: function (data) {
                switch (data) {
                    case 'Pending':
                        return decodeEntities('Pendente');
                    case 'Approved':
                        return decodeEntities('Aprovado');
                    case 'Denied':
                        return decodeEntities('Negado');
                }
            },
            savePriceSuggested: function (data) {
                return decodeEntities('Pre&#231;o alterado para') + ': ' + data.initials + ' ' + data.price;
            },
            saveSituation: function (data) {
                return decodeEntities('Status da negocia&#231;&#227;o alterado para') + ': ' + data.situation;
            },
            saveTextBudget: "PDF salvo com sucesso.",
            action: {
                open: "Abrir",
                clone: "Duplicar",
                draft: "Rascunho",
                original: "Original",
                confirmClone: "Deseja realmente duplicar o projeto?",
                remove: "Excluir",
                confirmRemove: "Deseja realmente excluir o projeto?",
                cloneNotification: function (name) {
                    return decodeEntities("Projeto ") + name + decodeEntities("  duplicado");
                },
                removeNotification: function (name) {
                    return decodeEntities("Projeto ") + name + decodeEntities("  deletado");
                },
                renameNotification: function (name) {
                    return decodeEntities("Projeto ") + name + decodeEntities("  renomeado");
                },

            formatPrice: function (price) {
                if (price == 0)
                    return 0;
                price = price.replace(",", ".");
                price = parseFloat(price);

                var p = price.toFixed(2).split(".");
                return p[0].split("").reverse().reduce(function (acc, price, i, orig) {
                    return price + (i && !(i % 3) ? "." : "") + acc;
                }, "") + "," + p[1];
            },

<script type="text/javascript">
        require(['mooble.web.boot'], function (boot) {
            boot({
                name: "home",
                contentSelector: "#homepage",
                url: "/",
                initialize: function (view, callback) {
                    require([
                        "mooble.web.home.index.Viewmodel",
                        "mooble.web.home.index.Controller",
                        "mooble.web.home.index.Events"
                    ], function (ViewModel, Controller, Events) {
                        var events = new Events(view.contentSelector);
                        var viewModel = new ViewModel(view.name, events, '50');
                        var controller = new Controller(view.contentSelector, viewModel);

                        callback && callback({
                            viewModel: viewModel,
                            controller: controller,
                        });
                    });
                },
            });
        });
    </script>
